details: This package is a controlled npm-ingestion / canary artifact. It ships backend-canary.js, which when required hashes the contents of /etc/hostname and the current operating-system username with SHA-256 and sends both hashes as the query parameters "host" and "user" in an HTTP GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle (errors swallowed). It reads no environment variable values, tokens, credential files or arbitrary file contents, and only hashes those two host-identity values. package.json declares no lifecycle hooks and no dependencies, and index.js only exports the string "controlled", so the callback fires only if backend-canary.js is imported explicitly. marker.txt carries the canary marker NPM_BACKEND_LATIN1_e47a97145c96357c83f9b09bceba931e.
